name: ligolo-ng
description:
Advanced, yet simple, tunneling/pivoting tool that uses a TUN interfaceLigolo-ng is a simple, lightweight and fast tool that allows pentesters to
establish tunnels from a reverse TCP/TLS connection using a tun interface
(without the need of SOCKS).
